info.title: NeuroSentio Copilot Agent
info.description: The standalone backend brain of NeuroSentio Daily Copilot. Manages user profiles, tasks, energy logs, and generates rule-based and LLM-powered daily plans. Designed for neurodivergent-friendly pacing.

get.description:
Returns the current user's profile.
If no profile exists, a default profile is created and returned.

put.description:
Update one or more profile fields.
Only provided fields are updated (partial update).

get.description:
Returns tasks for the current user.

- No filter → all tasks (any status)
- `?status=active` → open + in_progress (shorthand for copilot use)
- `?status=open`, `?status=done`, etc. → exact status match

parameters.name: status

schema.description: Filter by status. Allowed values: open, in_progress, done, skipped, deferred. Pass 'active' as a shorthand for open + in_progress. Omit to return all tasks.
schema.title: Status

Returns the raw structured context that the future AI agent will consume.
Useful for debugging and LLM integration prep.

post.summary: Generate a quick rule-based daily plan
post.description:
Generates a rule-based daily plan without LLM.

Rules:
- No energy logged → mode = normal, prompt to log energy
- battery < 30 → mode = recovery (1 task only)
- battery >= 30 → mode = normal (up to 3 tasks)
- > 5 open tasks + energy < 50 → lighter plan recommended
- Task priority: high → nearest due date → oldest created

Breaks a task into tiny, neurodivergent-friendly micro-actions.

- If micro-actions already exist for this task, returns them without regenerating
  (unless force_regenerate=true).
- If current_energy < 30, switches to recovery mode (fewer, smaller actions).
- Uses mock LLM by default — no API key required.
- Falls back to rule-based decomposition if LLM fails.

get.summary: Get all micro-actions for a task
get.description:
Returns all micro-actions for the given task, ordered by sort_order.
Scoped to the current user — another user's tasks return an empty list.

schema.title: Response Get Task Micro Actions Tasks  Task Id  Micro Actions Get

patch.description:
Update the status of a single micro-action.
Allowed values: open, done, snoozed, skipped, deferred.

post.summary: Split a micro-action into smaller actions
post.description:
This action still feels too big.

Splits it into 1–3 smaller actions inserted after the original in sort order.
The original action is NOT deleted — it stays in the list for reference.
If current_energy < 30, generates a lighter version (recovery mode).

Generates a neurodivergent-friendly morning plan.

- Selects micro-actions from open tasks (auto-decomposes if auto_decompose=true).
- Switches to recovery mode when energy < 30 or overload risk >= 60.
- Saves plan to DB and links selected micro-actions to plan_id.
- Adds transition suggestions (starting_work, making_call, recovery_break).
- Returns existing plan without regenerating unless force_regenerate=true.

get.description:
Returns today's morning plan if one has been generated.
Returns 404 if no plan exists for today — call POST /copilot/morning-plan to create one.

post.description:
Generates a gentle, neurodivergent-friendly transition script.

Supported types: leaving_house, starting_work, making_call, ending_day,
context_switch, recovery_break, custom.

If current_energy < 30, generates a shorter recovery version (≤ 3 steps).

post.description:
Paste any message text and receive 3 neurodivergent-friendly reply options:
short, warm, and detailed. A boundary option is included when:
- current_energy < 40
- user_intent includes decline/delay/boundary/not available
- include_boundary_option=true (default)

**This endpoint NEVER sends messages.**
All drafts are stored locally. No external connections.

get.description: Returns one reply draft by ID. Returns 404 if not found or belongs to another user.

patch.description:
Update a draft: select an option, save an edited reply, or change status.
Valid statuses: drafted | edited | selected | archived | deleted
The status 'sent' is intentionally not allowed — this service never sends messages.

delete.description:
Soft deletes the draft by setting status='deleted'.
The record is preserved in the database but excluded from default list results.
Use GET /reply/drafts?status=deleted to retrieve deleted drafts.

delete.summary: Purge/redact the original message from a reply draft
delete.description:
Individually purge the original message stored inside a reply draft,
replacing it with the placeholder '[redacted]'.

get.description:
Returns exactly one best next action based on current state.
Creates and saves a prompt row if one does not already exist.
Reuses existing active prompts where appropriate.

post.summary: Mark a next action as done
post.description:
Marks the prompt as done.
If source_type is micro_action, marks the linked micro-action as done too.
Snoozes the prompt for the specified number of minutes (5-1440).

Marks the prompt as skipped.
If source_type is micro_action, optionally marks the micro-action as skipped.

post.summary: Defer a next action to a later time
post.description: Defers the prompt to the specified datetime.

Adjusts the remaining day plan based on a trigger.

Triggers:
- low_energy: reduces actions, defers high-energy tasks, adds recovery block
- skipped_actions: simplifies plan to top 2 actions
- calendar_overload: reduces action count, adds recovery block
- urgent_message: adds one draft_reply action, keeps plan light
- manual: general replan
- recovery_mode: recovery-first plan
- stuck_tasks: includes at most one stuck task action

Preserves completed micro-actions.
